That night, between turns of the lamp, he wrote her a long letter about the color of the sea at dawn, though he knew she was probably grown now.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。路灯把空荡荡的街道照成一条条昏黄的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水，声音很快就散了。便利店的灯一直亮着，店员靠在柜台后打盹。早点铺的老板已经拉开卷帘门，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气。高楼的窗口大多黑着，只有零星几扇还亮，不知是有人失眠，还是有人刚下班。环卫工人推着车慢慢走，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。东边的天色开始发灰，再过一会儿，这座城市就要重新热闹起来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- Picture Russian nesting dolls: to reach the tiniest doll, you open one doll, then open the doll inside it, and keep going.\n- It stops when it reaches a piece so small the answer is obvious, like the last doll that doesn't open."}
